evidence.effect: EIA storage-day short around the WNGSR release (pre- plus post-announcement), whole sample
evidence.rule: On every EIA Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report day: sell the first-nearby NG future 90 min before the release (10:30 ET standard = 09:00 ET entry), buy back 30 min after (11:00 ET). Unconditional; no surprise data needed.
evidence.conversion: Annual 17.86% / 52 (paper annualizes with 52, fn 24) = 0.343% = 34.3 bp per event; x 0.30 ticks/bp at $3.00 = 10.3 ticks. evidence.sample: NYMEX NG first nearby, 2003-03..2018-12, 699 announcements, 5-minute Thomson Reuters Tick History data
evidence.decay_evidence: Table 8 Panel B (before 2011) raw 32.85%/yr (63.2 bp/event), Sharpe 4.22; Panel C (after 2011) raw 2.91%/yr (p 0.558; 5.6 bp/event), Sharpe 0.50; after bid-ask -0.90%/yr. Text: 'gradually decreasing to become insignificantly different from zero in the most recent period.' This is the published source of member K4-ngpre-01 (E.0 catalog K4-001, post-2011 null stated as the prior).

evidence.effect: Pre-announcement drift traded on an analyst-forecast predictor (informed-trading signal)
evidence.rule: Buy (sell) NG 90 min before the WNGSR release if the predictor ('informed' consensus of historically accurate analysts minus the Bloomberg consensus) is negative (positive); close 5 min before the release
evidence.conversion: No per-trade return reported in the retrieved text; only Sharpe and Sortino ratios.
evidence.sample: NG nearby, 2008-07..2016-01, 334 announcements (387 less 53 same-day WPSR days), 271 with non-zero predictor

evidence.effect: Market intraday momentum ROD -> LH, NG's own regression row
evidence.rule: r_LH (14:00-14:30 ET = 13:00-13:30 CT) regressed on r_ROD (previous 14:30 ET close to 14:00 ET); long if r_ROD > 0, short if < 0 at 14:00 ET, exit 14:30 ET (NG trading hours 09:00-14:30 ET in the paper)
evidence.conversion: Slope 3.02 (x100) = 0.0302: expected r_LH = 3.02 bp per 1% of r_ROD = 0.906 ticks per 1% |r_ROD| at $3.00. Clearing 1.5 x 2.408 = 3.61 ticks needs |r_ROD| >= 3.99%; clearing 1x needs 2.66%. Unconditional per-trade mean not reported for NG alone.
evidence.decay_evidence: Not reported per market; post-2020 class evidence: [shared, see reports/stage_e20_briefs/shared/baltussen_notes.md and shared/aalto_thesis_notes.md]. Hold is 30 min, under V2.2's 60-min minimum; the matching decision time is t3 = 13:00 CT but h60 exits 14:00 CT, 30 min after NG's 13:30 CT close.
evidence.source: Baltussen, Da, Lammers, Martens (2021), JFE 142, 377-403, Table B3 Panel B (on-disk EUR copy)
